properties.description: 17-story, 800-room hotel with 110,000 square feet of meeting and ballroom space, 17,000 square feet of ground-floor retail, an 8,000-square-foot lawn atop the fifth-floor rooftop amenity deck, two swimming pools, a fitness center with a spa treatment room, restaurant space, lobby lounge and bar. Hotel to be connected to the Miami Beach Convention Center by a climate-controlled skybridge.
